'''Senior Executive''' was a title in use by corporations such as [[TranStar Construction]]. [[Yasinda Bardak]], daughter of the company's owner, held the position of Senior Executive of TranStar's [[Tasariq]] branch.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|Tasariq: The Crystal Planet}}</ref>
